decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 11th August 2005 the retention of a single storey rear extension measuring 3.6m in depth, 5.1m in width, and maximum height of 3.7m, was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development exceeds the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A and D of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the volume of the single storey rear extension together with the volume of the existing front porch exceeds the maximum 50 cubic metre allowance.

Condition : 2 - Informative
Please note that your application is for the retention of the rear extension only and a decision has been made on this basis.  As the porch shown on your submitted drawing No. WEN/204/01 is proposed it cannot be included in an application for existing development and would require a separate application for a lawful development certifiacte. However, you should be aware that the porch as shown on your drawing would not constitute permitted development as it would be over 3 metres in height in any event.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the retention of single storey rear extension.
